meters on their page (ADR 0030, amended, for the token count). Counts only.

PersonResponse.description: A row of People: who the User is, and the Operator Overview's summary of them.

How much the people a Plan limits have of each resource it limits: each count above 0,

UseCountResponse.title: UseCountResponse

their resource use. Never a calendar's name or identifier, an account's email, or an event.
UserOverviewResponse.title: UserOverviewResponse

get.description:
Start the provider's consent for the signed-in User; reauthorizing a known `account`
suggests its email to the provider.

post.description:
Give one Plan, or with null the Default Plan, to up to 100 people at once, all or none,
and answer each person's Plan before and after and what they are over. With `dry_run`,
give nothing and answer the same, so who would be over is known before anyone confirms.

put.description:
Turn Plans on or off, and choose the Default Plan. Turning Plans on with no default makes
a Plan named "No limits" the default; the default cannot be cleared while Plans are on.
Turning them off is always allowed and keeps every Plan and assignment.

get.description:
Every Plan with how many people have it and how many of them have more than it allows,
the Plans setting, and the offered intervals.

post.description:
Add a Plan. Its key is the one asked for, or one made from its name; it never changes,
so billing can name it later.

delete.description: Remove a Plan that is not the default and that nobody has.

put.description:
Rename a Plan or change its limits; its key stays. New limits apply at once to new
rules, accounts, and tokens, and stop nothing that exists.

get.description: The calendar providers this installation configured, and how to connect each.

schema.title: Response List Providers Api V1 Providers Get
Response Recent Changes Api V1 Recent Changes Get
Response List Rules Api V1 Rules Get

get.description: The Installation Status of the User the token or session belongs to (ADR 0030).

One page of the people here, by part of their email, role, state, Installation Status,
Plan, and whether they are over a limit of it, each with what the Operator Overview shows
about them; never their calendars.

delete.description: Delete another User and every record they own; their projections are deleted.

get.description:
What the Operator Overview shows about one User, for an Installation Administrator.
Anyone else, and an unknown identifier, is answered 404, so nothing is revealed.

put.description:
Give a User their own Plan, or with null return them to the Default Plan. Allowed while
Plans are off, so an administrator can prepare; an administrator's own Plan limits them only
once they stop administering.
